seo_title: Cost of Living in Rio de Janeiro 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Rio de Janeiro per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: A city between the ocean and the mountains: visa-free for 90 days, famous beaches, carnival and a warm climate. Downsides are the long flight, the language barrier and safety concerns in certain districts.
